impact: GOOGL and MU deepen ties with one of their largest AI customers, locking in TPU and memory demand, though it ties up cash at a rich valuation. A strong ANT debut would support the wider AI trade including NBIS; a weak one would add to AI-bubble worries.
summary: Anthropic disclosed in an updated IPO prospectus on Tuesday that seven technology companies, including Nvidia, Alphabet's Google and Micron, have agreed to buy a combined $26 billion of its stock when it goes public. CNBC reported Anthropic aims to price on Nov 18 and start trading on Nasdaq on Nov 19. Micron shares rose about 1.5% premarket Wednesday to around $736.
title: Google, Nvidia and Micron among 7 firms buying $26B of Anthropic IPO stock
